scope: Additional native companion/release acceptance, separate from the preserved 263 original requirements.

requirements.title: Responsive reception workspace and phone navigation
requirements.verified_behavior: Final built Persian RTL interface; desktop workflows, mobile Today/Tasks/Calls/More, narrow cards and permission-aware actions have actual browser evidence. Earlier runs remain explicitly attributed to their original bundles with exact source-equivalence proofs for the final five labels and prior color-only correction.
acceptance_limits: Browser evidence does not establish physical-device or assistive-technology acceptance.

requirements.title: Verified connection and session lifecycle
requirements.verified_behavior: Ten connection/session checks passed against a synthetic API and controlled native bridge, covering credential-free handshake, transport rejection, recovery, server revocation and offline logout barriers. Their original bundle provenance is retained; the final five-label-only amendment leaves platform and session source unchanged.
acceptance_limits: Bridge fixture behavior does not prove OS encryption or real-server TLS deployment.

requirements.title: Native host and protected storage
requirements.verified_behavior: Five desktop security groups and five actual Linux Electron host launch checks passed; host sources are unchanged by the final UI-label amendment; four Android JVM server-policy checks passed. Source implements narrow bridge, OS-vault or safe ephemeral storage, server-bound Android Keystore encryption, disabled cleartext/backup/debugging and secure window.
acceptance_limits: Windows DPAPI and Android Keystore/device lifecycle must be exercised on target devices. Root/headless Linux test disables the process sandbox for that test only; production host source retains sandboxed rendering.

requirements.title: Windows installer and portable executable
requirements.verified_behavior: Actual unsigned NSIS assisted installer and portable EXE built. Both compressed archives pass integrity checks, have no PE certificate table, and contain an app.asar identical to the verified x64 payload and all 61 final web files.
acceptance_limits: Local Linux cross-build uses bounded installed-builder extraction, not Windows code execution. No installer/upgrade/uninstall or publisher identity acceptance.

requirements.title: Android APK and app bundle
requirements.verified_behavior: Actual debug APK and unsigned release APK/AAB built; ZIP CRC, unique entries, all 63 embedded public assets, real manifest identity/version/min24/target36 and signature classification verified.
acceptance_limits: Debug APK has a local development signature. Release APK/AAB need the intended publisher key before distribution. AAB is not directly installable. No emulator or physical-device execution.

requirements.title: Native installation and device acceptance
requirements.verified_behavior: Acceptance checklist and test builds are supplied.
acceptance_limits: Requires actual Windows installation/upgrade/uninstall and Android installation, network changes, permissions, microphone, RTL, screen-reader and OS-vault tests on intended devices.

requirements.title: GitHub verification and release automation
requirements.verified_behavior: Commit-pinned workflows, quality dependency, native jobs, explicit signing inputs, signature checks and guarded optional draft release are implemented. Actionlint and 26 isolated collector fixtures passed.
acceptance_limits: No matching authorized GitHub repository/remote run or Docker engine was available. Execute the configured workflow and retain actual native runner/container outcomes.

requirements.title: Production publisher signing
requirements.verified_behavior: Workflow validates requested Windows Authenticode and Android signatures; collector binds Windows evidence to actual EXE hashes and rejects stale unsigned metadata.
acceptance_limits: Organization-controlled signing credentials, repository secrets/access and store identity are required. No production signature or public release exists in this delivery.

requirements.title: Exact release set and file identity
requirements.verified_behavior: Final collector accepted exactly five compiled packages and three dependency inventories; all manifest sizes/hashes independently matched the actual output. Stale version, mixed architecture/signing mode, missing pair, intermediate and mismatched signature fixtures fail closed.
acceptance_limits: Checksums establish bytes; they are not publisher authentication or proof of runtime safety.

requirements.title: Bundled notices and dependency inventory
requirements.verified_behavior: Final shared assets include generated notices for 21 locked runtime packages; three actual installed npm dependency graphs are retained as CycloneDX inventories.
acceptance_limits: Dependency inventories include build tooling and are not a vulnerability scan or universal license-compliance certification.

limits: Signed publisher release, actual Windows/Android device acceptance, remote CI/container execution and live clinic/provider deployment are explicitly unverified.
Local Windows package adaptation is a bounded extraction of the builder-provided unsigned NSIS uninstaller; it never runs Windows code.
The actual Linux Electron launch used isolated root/headless flags, reported OS secure storage unavailable and does not certify Windows secure storage.
